Starting on April 16 and ending on November 19, the league saw [[Shanghai Shenhua F.C.|Shanghai Shenhua]] win the championship. ==Promotion and relegation== '''Teams promoted from [[1994 Chinese Jia-B League]]''' * [[Qingdao Hainiu F.C.|Qingdao Hainiu]] * [[Tianjin Jinmen Tiger F.C.|Tianjin Samsung]] '''Relegated after end of [[1994 Chinese Jia-A League]]''' * [[Guangzhou City F.C.|Shenyang Liuyao]] * [[Jiangsu F.C.|Jiangsu Maint]] ==Overview== It was contested by 12 teams, and [[Shanghai Shenhua F.C.|Shanghai Shenhua]] won the championship. ==Personnel== {| class="wikitable sortable" style="font-size:95%" |- !Team !Manager |- | [[Bayi Football Team|August 1st]] | |- | [[Beijing Guoan F.C.|Beijing Guoan]] | {{flagicon|CHN}} [[Jin Zhiyang]] |- | [[Dalian Shide F.C.|Dalian Wanda]] | {{flagicon|CHN}} [[Chi Shangbin]] |- | [[Guangdong Winnerway F.C.|Guangdong Hongyuan]] | {{flagicon|CHN}} [[He Jinlun]] |- | [[Guangzhou F.C.|Guangzhou Apollo]] | {{flagicon|CHN}} [[Zhang Jingtian]] |- | [[Shandong Taishan F.C.|Jinan Taishan General]] | {{flagicon|CHN}} [[Yin Tiesheng]] |- | [[Liaoning F.C.|Liaoning]] | {{flagicon|CHN}} [[Li Shubin]] |- | [[Qingdao Hainiu F.C.|Qingdao Hainiu]] | {{flagicon|CHN}} [[Xu Yonglai]] |- | [[Shanghai Shenhua F.C.|Shanghai Shenhua]] | {{flagicon|CHN}} [[Xu Genbao]] |- | [[Sichuan First City F.C.|Sichuan Guancheng]] | |- | [[Tianjin Jinmen Tiger F.C.|Tianjin Samsung]] | {{flagicon|CHN}} [[Lin Xinjiang]] |- | [[Yanbian Funde F.C.|Yanbian Hyundai]] | {{flagicon|CHN}} [[Zheng Zhongxie]] |} == Foreign players == As a military-owned team, August 1st were not allowed to sign any foreign players. {| class="wikitable" !
